findings.title: ensure_loaded! races with load_locale on @loaded_locales
findings.body: `ensure_loaded!` does `@loaded_locales ||= []` outside LOAD_MUTEX. Concurrent requests can each create a new array, and one thread can replace an array that another is appending to, so a locale load can be lost or repeated. `reload!` also sets `@loaded_locales = []` without the lock. Initialize and check inside the mutex.

findings.title: Fallback list evaluated against SiteSetting.default_locale, which may be unavailable at boot or invalid
findings.body: `FallbackLocaleList#[]` calls `SiteSetting.default_locale` on every lookup. During early boot, migrations or asset precompile, the DB or SiteSetting may not be ready, so any I18n lookup that consults fallbacks can raise. Also, `default_locale` can be nil or blank, and `.to_sym` on nil raises NoMethodError. `.compact` runs after `.to_sym`, so it cannot protect against that.

findings.title: Fallbacks included into the backend class at initializer time
findings.body: `I18n.backend.class.send(:include, ...)` depends on the backend class at initializer time and on initializer ordering. The comment says it must run after 02-freedom_patches.rb, but the filename `i18n.rb` sorts alphabetically before `pluralization.rb` and the numbered files. This is fragile, and the file may load before the freedom patch.

findings.title: ensure_loaded! on every request
findings.body: `set_locale` runs for every request. It builds a fresh array and calls `SiteSetting.default_locale` each time, then loads up to three locales' translations. The first request for each locale pays a large synchronous load while holding a global mutex. Non-English locales also load the English and default-locale files.
